question: total sidewalk length km
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 2) AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk';

question: average footprint area residential buildings m2
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)), 1) AS avg_footprint_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'residential';

question: top 5 largest building footprints m2
sql: SELECT names['primary'] AS name, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry), 1) AS footprint_m2, height FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: total area of school sites hectares
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))) / 10000.0, 2) AS total_hectares FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'education';

question: how long is Passeio Marítimo de Algés km
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 2) AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names['primary'] = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés';

question: road length by category km
sql: SELECT class AS road_category, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 2) AS total_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY total_km DESC;
